title: Evolution Banned? The Shocking Case from Pakistan
tags: Pakistani professor signs written apology for propagating
description:
Darwin’s theory of evolution has always clashed with religious dogma, but in Pakistan it recently turned into a chilling incident. A biology professor, Sher Ali, with degrees in genetics, was forced to apologize publicly for teaching evolution—and even made to declare that “women are inferior to men” under pressure from religious leaders. This echoes Galileo’s forced apology centuries ago, showing how religion still tries to silence science.

In this episode of Pale Blue Thoughts, we examine how Pakistan treats evolution, compare it to India where NCERT textbooks have removed evolution from early classes, and reflect on why this pseudoscientific rejection harms entire societies. From Zakir Naik dismissing evolution as “just a theory” to textbooks teaching that Allah directly created all life, the rejection of evidence is striking.

But science stands firm: evolution is no longer just a theory but a proven fact supported by mountains of fossil and genetic evidence. Suppressing it in classrooms means suppressing the very foundation of biology. This video also contrasts patriotism vs nationalism, and why nationalism tied to religious pride only pushes nations backwards, while patriotism coupled with scientific temper builds progress.
